evidence.description: requestAPNConsent directly obtains UIApplication.shared and invokes remote-notification registration.
The in-app message callbacks directly invoke Analytics.shared.brazeIAM rather than receiving an analytics dependency.

candidates.explanation: BrazeService directly accesses global singleton services for operational behavior, including notification registration and analytics recording. These dependencies are not supplied through an explicit, replaceable boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: BrazeService declares mutable instance state, including braze and notificationAuthorizationStatus, and exposes a static shared instance without actor isolation or synchronization.
initBraze mutates the shared instance's braze property and accesses it again inside a MainActor task.
The asynchronous notification-settings retrieval writes notificationAuthorizationStatus without a visible isolation or synchronization boundary.

candidates.explanation: Mutable BrazeService instance state is reachable through the publicly exposed BrazeService.shared instance. The class has no actor isolation or synchronization protecting that state. The MainActor annotation on one task does not protect the other accesses to the same instance state.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation
